raised: The small grey line 'בכל עמוד של מוצר יש שורה…' meant little to the reader

'מסלול' is never explained on the page

No fee information
No numbers on return or risk
Doesn't say how long the legal period for קרן השתלמות lasts
Can't tell which is better for S&P 500: קופת גמל להשקעה or חשבון ניירות ערך
No way to check what you already have through work, or whether you can pick S&P 500 in your pension
No order of steps or guidance on how much to put where
Would drop most investment cards (TA indices, MSCI, Nasdaq, government bonds)
Would drop the 'לבחירה עצמית' cards except חשבון ניירות ערך
Would drop the 'לילדים' section
Would drop מק"מ and קרן כספית מתחדשת from the short-term cards
Would drop the 'מה האתר עוד לא מכסה' section

problems.why: The reader points out that מק"מ appears twice, once in each section, and asks why; that is the duplicated makam entries the person flagged.
